newsitem.title: CHINA: China condemns Peru guerillas for hostage taking.
newsitem.headline: China condemns Peru guerillas for hostage taking.

text.p: China's communist government on Friday condemned a leftist Peruvian guerilla group for seizing hundreds of hostages in the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima, the Xinhua news agency said.

Around 20 guerrillas of the Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement seized nearly 400 men as hostages after storming the residence on Tuesday. The guerillas have threatened to kill their captives if up to 500 jailed comrades are not released.
"We sternly condemn this act of terrorism," Xinhua quoted Foreign Ministry spokesman Shen Guofang as saying.

The Chinese government expressed its "grave concern" over the incident, Shen said, adding that Beijing hoped the parties involved would ensure the safety of the hostages and end the crisis as soon as possible.
